title: Alfajores
hookLine: Argentina-inspired alfajores with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Make the Dough: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and lemon zest. Gradually mix in flour and cornstarch to form a dough. Chill for 1 hour. Incorporate {m53138_1}, {m53138_2}, {m53138_3}, and {m53138_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure all purpose flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake the Cookies: Roll out the dough, cut into circles, and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 12-15 minutes. Let cool. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs. Incorporate {m53138_5}, {m53138_6}, {m53138_7}, and {m53138_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Assemble: Spread dulce de leche on one cookie, then sandwich with another. Roll the edges in coconut flakes. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Chill the dough before rolling it out to make it easier to handle and to prevent the cookies from spreading too much while baking.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip the alfajores in melted chocolate and let them set on a wire rack for an extra decadent treat. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
